Rae (Docs): Opening a small PR to add a "Migration notes" section to Dedicated docs for the autoscale policy rename (old: autoscale_strategy -> new: autoscaleMode) and to include concrete terraform/CLI examples. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2601
Ibrahim (SDK): Thanks — heads up: the JS snippet still uses `autoscale_strategy: 'balanced'` in one place. Our SDK accepts `autoscaleMode: 'Balanced'` now (capitalization).
Rae (Docs): good catch, will standardize to `autoscaleMode` and note the capitalization differences across tools.
Sofia (Infra): When you update the terraform example, please include both the provider var and the resource block example. Many customers copy the resource. Also mention `min_replicas` vs older `replica_min`.
Rae (Docs): adding both. Also planning a short migration table: old name -> new name -> example value.
Diego (SRE): Can we add a one-paragraph explanation of how cooldown timers interact with rolling drains? Folks often confuse scale-down cooldown with drain timeout which can flush KV caches. Suggest a short troubleshooting bullet.
Rae (Docs): added a troubleshooting bullet: "If you observe higher tail latency after scale events, verify scale_down_cooldown >= drain_timeout to avoid premature draining" and linked to runtime drain doc.
tara (QA): CI link check failed: /internal/terraform/vars -> 404 (found in docs/dedicated/migrate.md line 42). Correct path is /guides/terraform/variables.
doc-bot: Link check error logged for PR #2601
Rae (Docs): fixed link to /guides/terraform/variables. Also replaced the JS/py SDK snippets to use the canonical `batch_limit` param and added runnable examples for both languages:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# migration example: prefer explicit param name
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-dedicated-2', prompt='Test', batch_limit=4, autoscaleMode='Balanced')
print(resp.text)
```
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood()
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-dedicated-2', prompt: 'Test', batch_limit: 4, autoscaleMode: 'Balanced' })
console.log(res.text)
```
Diego (SRE): Nice. One more: add a short on-prem note recommending conservative batch_limit (<=3) for tiny GPU pools and show terraform var example: `default_batch_limit = 3`.
Ibrahim (SDK): Also file a follow-up issue to add these snippets to docs-smoke so param regressions are caught.
Rae (Docs): filed issue #512 for snippet smoke tests. PR updated: migration table, terraform/resource examples, cooldown troubleshooting, SDK snippet fixes, and link corrections.
doc-bot: All checks passed for PR #2601
Rae (Docs): Merged. Will follow up with a separate PR that includes a small cost vs latency table comparing 128/512 token workloads (requested by support). Closing thread. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
